title: One canonical local-first session owns durable musical truth
accepted_boundary: Hardware, DAW, plug-in and UI adapters consume the same versioned session; none becomes an independent source of truth.
evidence_gate: Save, reopen, migration, undo, recovery and cross-adapter round-trip tests.

title: Separate desired state from observations
accepted_boundary: Store desired values beside timestamped hardware and DAW observations instead of overwriting either side.
evidence_gate: Synthetic conflict, stale observation and reconnect tests; physical evidence for each adapter mapping.

title: Require evidence-aware device and host capabilities
accepted_boundary: A declared profile may plan work; only qualified evidence may activate write-capable or real-time routes.
evidence_gate: Exact device, firmware, OS, driver, connection, DAW and direction qualification record.

title: Hardware Learn creates receive-only user profiles
accepted_boundary: Learn pads, keys, buttons, encoders, faders and transport from observed messages; feedback tests are a separate write gate.
evidence_gate: Repeated control samples, range validation, ambiguity handling and explicit outbound-feedback qualification.

title: Preserve rich sampler construction data
accepted_boundary: Keep source audio, pad assignments, slices, timing, velocity, tuning intent, modes, zones, choke groups, envelopes, filters, effects and output intent where evidenced.
evidence_gate: Field-by-field XPJ fixtures and semantic reopen comparison; unmapped vendor fields remain explicit.

title: Select recording destination, monitoring and processing independently
accepted_boundary: Plan hardware, DAW or both destinations; hardware, DAW or direct monitoring; clean, processed or clean-with-monitor-effects recording.
evidence_gate: Endpoint ownership, simultaneous-capture, latency, dropout, clean-source preservation and reopen tests.

title: Model clock domains independently
accepted_boundary: Transport, MIDI clock, audio sample clock, word clock, timecode, position and control state have separate authorities and evidence.
evidence_gate: One authority per domain, measured rate/jitter/offset, disconnect/reconnect and long-run drift tests.

title: Acknowledge parameter writes instead of assuming success
accepted_boundary: Plan, dispatch, observe, acknowledge, verify and commit; mismatch and timeout remain pending/conflicted.
evidence_gate: Qualified mapping, revision recheck, bounded timeout, target observation and rollback/retry policy.

title: Use non-destructive hardware and DAW branches
accepted_boundary: Preserve both variants, compare to a common ancestor, merge independent changes, resolve collisions and extract selected sections.
evidence_gate: Persistent commit graph, crash recovery, undo/redo, restore point and semantic merge tests.

title: Keep real-time callbacks bounded and allocation-free
accepted_boundary: No files, database, network, device enumeration, parsing, logging or unbounded allocation on audio or MIDI callbacks.
evidence_gate: Real-time audit, stress/dropout measurement, queue saturation, sanitizer and host soak tests.

title: Run one per-user background hardware service
accepted_boundary: The service owns device endpoints and canonical sessions; plug-ins and apps are reconnecting clients.
evidence_gate: Authenticated IPC, single-instance ownership, restart recovery, version negotiation and least-privilege install tests.

title: Treat VST3 and future wrappers as thin clients
accepted_boundary: Plug-ins persist session identity and exchange bounded state; they do not enumerate hardware or parse projects on real-time threads.
evidence_gate: SDK licence review, Cubase/Reason host matrix, state reopen, automation, latency and crash-isolation tests.

title: Do not depend on MPC Beats
accepted_boundary: MPC Beats may be a clean-room workflow reference or optional official-assisted host, never the required bridge engine or transport.
evidence_gate: Fresh Windows install works without MPC Beats; assisted profile remains optional and labelled.

title: Prioritize Windows and MPC Sample as the first vertical slice
accepted_boundary: Prove discovery, read-only project intake, MIDI directions, audio route, service ownership and one DAW path before expanding platforms.
evidence_gate: Windows 10/11 matrix, exact MPC firmware/driver, Cubase or Reason reopen, recovery and installer tests.

title: Allow DAW playback without connected hardware after approved asset intake
accepted_boundary: A copied, rights-cleared, complete session can play from the DAW while hardware is absent; the original project remains unchanged.
evidence_gate: Asset completeness, audio equivalence, timing, effects fallback, rights and offline reopen tests.

title: Associate and reopen matching hardware and DAW projects
accepted_boundary: Stable project identity links hardware, bridge and DAW variants without filename-only guessing or automatic overwrite.
evidence_gate: Fingerprint collision handling, moved-file recovery, duplicate identities, disconnect/reconnect and user confirmation tests.

title: Synchronize transport with one authority and echo suppression
accepted_boundary: Play, stop, continue, tempo and position are separate mapped messages; never create a feedback loop.
evidence_gate: Isolated Start/Stop capture, mediated DAW port, echo window, rate limit, authority handoff and physical two-way test.

title: Translate automation only through qualified mappings
accepted_boundary: Each mapping defines direction, range, curve, units, rate limit, acknowledgement and conflict policy.
evidence_gate: Per-parameter device and host evidence, boundary values, saturation, echo prevention and round-trip comparison.

title: Keep device, DAW and platform adapters neutral
accepted_boundary: MPC Sample is the reference profile, not a hard-coded limitation; later devices use the same contracts.
evidence_gate: Synthetic second-device profiles and no reference-computer endpoint IDs in persisted intent.

title: Support consumer, professional, OEM and SDK packaging
accepted_boundary: Keep proprietary engine ownership compatible with B2C, B2B, manufacturer, DAW-vendor and distribution agreements.
evidence_gate: Counsel-approved licences, SDK boundary, API stability, support/SLA model and signed distribution.

title: Use clean-room product research and original assets
accepted_boundary: Transfer workflow ideas and contracts, not competitor code, binaries, branding, layouts, manuals, presets, samples or proprietary assets.
evidence_gate: Provenance record, third-party notices, asset licence review and release counsel sign-off.

title: Keep implemented, experimental, scaffolded and unavailable claims distinct
accepted_boundary: Compilation, endpoint visibility or a UI model is not broad device/DAW qualification.
evidence_gate: Compatibility matrix tied to exact evidence records and regression runs.

title: Expand to mobile and other platforms only after the Windows proof
accepted_boundary: Companion control, direct bridge host and mobile DAW integration are separate modes with separate capabilities.
evidence_gate: Native runtime, permission, hardware, connection, audio/MIDI and DAW tests on each platform.

title: Do not infer mixing-desk control from optical audio
accepted_boundary: An optical desk behind an interface is an audio and clock route unless a separate documented MIDI, serial, USB or network control path is qualified.
evidence_gate: Physical route, channel assignment, clock lock and control-protocol tests remain separate.
